events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, bringing together half a million people for '3 Days of Peace & Music'.

angles.name: Summer of Love Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the original Woodstock. What a moment in music history. Did you know it was actually held on a dairy farm in Bethel, New York?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, we remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away at the age of 42.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music continues to define generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, succumbing to his injuries six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: Thirty years ago today, a tragic event in Las Vegas. Tupac Shakur's influence on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost a true innovator. Jimi Hendrix redefined the electric guitar and left an unmatched legacy.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years of Abbey Road! More than just an album, it gave us one of the most famous photos in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting have given us so many Pretenders classics.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that swagger and those anthems.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless single 'Imagine' on this day in 1971.

angles.name: A Message of Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listen to music forever. Who remembers their first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic film franchise since the premiere of 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Which 007 film or theme tune is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The Eclectic White Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the incredible 'White Album'. So diverse, so many classics! What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, we remember the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.
